program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (12.0, 8.0, 18.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),       # input pair L (flicker noise + gain)
    "Itail": (36e-6, 24e-6, 60e-6),
    "Lp":    (1.5, 0.5, 2.0),       # PMOS mirror load L
    "gmid7": (12.0, 9.0, 15.0),     # 2nd stage PMOS gm/Id
    "L7":    (0.6, 0.35, 1.0),
    "I7":    (130e-6, 80e-6, 170e-6),
    "Cc":    (1.0e-12, 0.6e-12, 1.6e-12),
    "kRz":   (1.8, 1.0, 4.0),       # Rz = kRz/gm7
    "Ln":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),       # NMOS current-source L
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    gmidn = 12.0
    I1 = p["Itail"] / 2
    # input pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5, vsb=0.3)
    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", 10.0, p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.7)
    # second stage PMOS CS
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], p["I7"], vds=0.9)
    # NMOS current sources (all from ibias diode, same L / gm/Id)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], p["Itail"], vds=0.35)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], p["I7"], vds=0.9)

    Cc = p["Cc"]
    Rz = p["kRz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # vinp drives the mirror-output side so that stage-1 out (x) is inverting w.r.t. vinp,
    # and the PMOS CS 2nd stage inverts again -> vout non-inverting w.r.t. vinp
    n.dev("M1", "y", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)     # diode side
    n.dev("M2", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)     # output side
    n.dev("M3", "y", "y", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "y", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "x", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    C2 = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (C1 * Cc + C1 * C2 + C2 * Cc) / (2 * PI)
    zden = Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m7.gm)
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * zden) if zden > 0 else 1e15
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3))
    slew = min(p["Itail"] / Cc, p["I7"] / (C2 + Cc))
    power = vdd * (iref + p["Itail"] + p["I7"])
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.05
    # thermal noise only (flicker adds at 1 kHz)
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    sn = 2 * 4 * kT * (2 / 3) / m1.gm * (1 + m3.gm / m1.gm)
    noise = math.sqrt(sn) * 3.0  # crude flicker allowance
    cmrr_db = db(A1 * 2 * m1.gm / max(m5.gds, 1e-12) / A1 * 1.0) if m5.gds > 0 else 80
    psrr_db = gain_db - 6
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 * tau
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew, "power": power,
               "swing": swing, "noise_1k": noise, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "psrr_db": psrr_db,
               "settle": settle}
